title: Atlantic International Corp. Expands Footprint with New Temple, TX Location
description: Atlantic International Corp. announced the expansion of its subsidiary Lyneer Staffing Solutions into Temple, TX, supporting a leading industrial automation company. This strategic move aims to strengthen the company's regional presence and provide more responsive, tailored workforce solutions to its clients.

title: Ferrovanadium Industry Trends and Market Opportunities, 2025-2030: Growth in Demand for Vanadium Redox Batteries for Large-Scale Energy Storage
description: The ferrovanadium market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 4.96% from 2023 to 2030, driven by increasing demand for high-strength steel, advancements in aerospace, and the expansion of electric vehicle production. However, volatility in raw material prices and competition from alternative materials pose challenges.

title: Staffing 360 Solutions Soars On $25M Buyout Deal With Atlantic: Details
description: Staffing 360 Solutions (STAF) shares surged after the company announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by Atlantic International Corp. (ATLN) for around $25 million. The combined entity is expected to have a pro-forma revenue of approximately $620 million.
